settings.question: What are the cheapest blank t-shirts to buy in bulk?
settings.answer: The cheapest blank t-shirts in bulk are undecorated liquidation overstock tees bought by the case pack rather than as singles. Because there's no decoration, no brand markup, and the stock is overrun inventory, the per-shirt cost lands well below typical wholesale. Bayou Blanks tees are a flat $1 a shirt, the same in every size and pack.

settings.question: How does per-unit pricing work?
settings.answer: Every pack shows one price, but the number that matters is the per-unit price: the pack price divided by how many shirts are inside. At Bayou that's a flat $1 a shirt, the same in every size and pack, so a 4-pack is $4 and a 12-pack is $12. Pricing by the unit lets you compare honestly instead of being fooled by the bigger sticker.

settings.question: Why are Bayou Blanks' t-shirts so cheap?
settings.answer: They're liquidation overstock — genuine, inspected blank apparel that was overproduced or cleared by the original supplier. Bayou buys it by the pallet and passes it on by the unit, so you get real blanks at clearance economics instead of paying first-run wholesale markups.

settings.question: Is there a minimum order for bulk blank t-shirts?
settings.answer: No. The smallest order is a single 4-pack, and the per-unit price doesn't change based on how many packs you buy — one pack costs the same per shirt as twenty. You scale up only when you want more units, not to unlock a price.

settings.question: Do I need a wholesale or reseller account to get these prices?
settings.answer: No. There's no application, reseller license, or business account required. The per-unit price is public and the same for everyone — decorators, resellers, teams, and one-off buyers all pay the same rate by the pack.

settings.question: Can I get plus and extended sizes in bulk at the same price?
settings.answer: Yes. Extended and plus sizes (2XL through 5XL) are stocked deep and priced at the same per-unit rate as standard sizes — there's no upcharge for going big. Extended sizing is one of the areas most discount blank suppliers run short on, so it's a genuine strength of the in-stock catalog.
